page: Microsoft Azure L12aos_v5 is a storage-optimized virtual machine instance deployed on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The hardware configuration features 12 dedicated x86_64 AMD vCPUs coupled with 96.0 GB of system memory, providing an 8.0 GB memory-to-vCPU allocation ratio. The instance does not include integrated hardware GPU accelerators and does not come with complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

A central feature of the L12aos_v5 is its direct-attached NVMe storage tier, supplying 8640 GB of high-speed local NVMe SSD capacity. The instance is also Premium Storage capable, allowing workloads to complement local NVMe storage with remote disk configurations when required for redundancy or persistent operations.

The dense combination of an 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio and expansive local NVMe disk minimizes reliance on network-attached storage for low-latency operations, resulting in qualitative resource efficiency for high-IOPS applications. The hardware envelope fits large relational and NoSQL database management systems, real-time analytics clusters, transactional processing pipelines, and data search indexing.
description: Microsoft Azure L12aos_v5 is a storage-optimized virtual machine powered by 12 dedicated x86_64 AMD vCPUs and 96.0 GB of memory on Microsoft Hyper-V. Delivering an 8.0 GB memory-per-core ratio, the system integrates a massive 8640 GB local NVMe SSD storage array alongside Premium Storage capabilities. The architecture excludes hardware GPU acceleration and complimentary public IPv4 networking. With its dense local disk allocation and substantial RAM footprint, the instance offers cost-efficient local input/output density by reducing dependencies on external block storage services for high-throughput workloads. This balance of dedicated AMD compute, high memory capacity, and expansive NVMe SSD storage makes the instance appropriate for large databases, transactional engines, data warehousing, search index clusters, and logging platforms.
